_comment: FETAN's Executive Dashboard figures, defined as Fineract reports.
A report in Fineract is a row in stretchy_report holding a SQL query, exposed at
GET /runreports/<name>. Defining them here rather than through the admin UI is
what keeps them in version control: a report created by clicking exists in one
database only and is absent from every other environment.
Requirement source: FETAN SRS §1.1 Executive Dashboard —
'Demographics Breakdown: visual charts categorizing total members by gender
'Financial Summaries: aggregated real-time metrics split by gender for Total
Savings, Total Shares, and Total Loans'
No schema changes are needed: m_client already stores gender_cv_id and
⚠️ Age bands are <18 / 18-35 / >35 taken literally from the SRS. Confirm the
boundaries with FETAN (open question Q8) — note 18-35 and >35 leave 35
Parameters: OfficeIdSelectOne is a Fineract-provided parameter that renders an
office picker. ${officeId} is substituted at run time; the hierarchy match makes
a parent office include all of its branches.

reports.description: Total members split by gender. Dashboard: demographics chart.
reports.reportSql: select coalesce(cv.code_value, 'Not specified') as "Gender", count(c.id) as "Members" from m_client c join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id left join m_code_value cv on cv.id = c.gender_cv_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select ounder.hierarchy from m_office ounder where ounder.id = ${officeId}), '%') and c.status_enum = 300 group by coalesce(cv.code_value, 'Not specified') order by 2 desc

reports.reportName: FETAN Member Demographics by Age Band
reports.description: Active members grouped into the age bands in FETAN's SRS (<18, 18-35, >35).
reports.reportSql: select band as "Age Band", count(*) as "Members" from (select case when c.date_of_birth is null then 'Unknown' when extract(year from age(current_date, c.date_of_birth)) < 18 then 'Under 18' when extract(year from age(current_date, c.date_of_birth)) <= 35 then '18 to 35' else 'Over 35' end as band from m_client c join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select ounder.hierarchy from m_office ounder where ounder.id = ${officeId}), '%') and c.status_enum = 300) banded group by band order by case band when 'Under 18' then 1 when '18 to 35' then 2 when 'Over 35' then 3 else 4 end

reports.description: Total savings balance held, split by member gender. Dashboard: financial summary.
reports.reportSql: select coalesce(cv.code_value, 'Not specified') as "Gender", count(distinct c.id) as "Members", coalesce(sum(sa.account_balance_derived), 0) as "Total Savings" from m_savings_account sa join m_client c on c.id = sa.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id left join m_code_value cv on cv.id = c.gender_cv_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select ounder.hierarchy from m_office ounder where ounder.id = ${officeId}), '%') and sa.status_enum = 300 group by coalesce(cv.code_value, 'Not specified') order by 3 desc

reports.description: Share capital held, split by member gender. Dashboard: financial summary.
reports.reportSql: select coalesce(cv.code_value, 'Not specified') as "Gender", count(distinct c.id) as "Members", coalesce(sum(sa.total_approved_shares), 0) as "Shares Held", coalesce(sum(sa.total_approved_shares * sp.unit_price), 0) as "Share Value" from m_share_account sa join m_client c on c.id = sa.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id join m_share_product sp on sp.id = sa.product_id left join m_code_value cv on cv.id = c.gender_cv_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select ounder.hierarchy from m_office ounder where ounder.id = ${officeId}), '%') and sa.status_enum = 300 group by coalesce(cv.code_value, 'Not specified') order by 4 desc

reports.description: Outstanding loan principal, split by member gender. Dashboard: financial summary.
reports.reportSql: select coalesce(cv.code_value, 'Not specified') as "Gender", count(distinct c.id) as "Borrowers", count(l.id) as "Loans", coalesce(sum(l.principal_outstanding_derived), 0) as "Outstanding Principal" from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id left join m_code_value cv on cv.id = c.gender_cv_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select ounder.hierarchy from m_office ounder where ounder.id = ${officeId}), '%') and l.loan_status_id = 300 group by coalesce(cv.code_value, 'Not specified') order by 4 desc

reports.description: Internal contact directory (SRS §2). Reads the fetan_contact_directory datatable and resolves department and branch names, so the whole directory comes back in one call.
reports.reportSql: select cd."Department" as "Department", c."Contact Name" as "Contact", c."Job Title" as "Job Title", o.name as "Branch", c."Phone" as "Phone", c."Email" as "Email", c."Notes" as "Notes" from fetan_contact_directory c join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id join (select cv.id as id, cv.code_value as "Department", cv.order_position as pos from m_code_value cv join m_code cc on cc.id = cv.code_id where cc.code_name = 'FETANDepartment') cd on cd.id = c."FETANDepartment_cd_Department" where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') order by cd.pos, o.hierarchy, c."Contact Name"

reports.description: Headline totals for the dashboard: members, savings, shares and loans in one row.
reports.reportSql: select (select count(*) from m_client c join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') and c.status_enum = 300) as "Active Members", (select count(*) from m_client c join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') and c.status_enum = 100) as "Pending Members", (select coalesce(sum(sa.account_balance_derived), 0) from m_savings_account sa join m_client c on c.id = sa.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') and sa.status_enum = 300) as "Total Savings", (select coalesce(sum(sh.total_approved_shares * sp.unit_price), 0) from m_share_account sh join m_client c on c.id = sh.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id join m_share_product sp on sp.id = sh.product_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') and sh.status_enum = 300) as "Total Share Value", (select coalesce(sum(l.principal_outstanding_derived), 0) from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') and l.loan_status_id = 300) as "Loans Outstanding", (select count(*) from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') and l.loan_status_id = 100) as "Loans Awaiting Approval"

reports.description: Loan receivable headline: principal collected vs still owed on active loans. FETAN detail §4 Loan Receivable.
reports.reportSql: select count(l.id) as "Active Loans", coalesce(sum(l.principal_disbursed_derived), 0) as "Principal Disbursed", coalesce(sum(l.principal_repaid_derived), 0) as "Collected", coalesce(sum(l.principal_outstanding_derived), 0) as "Uncollected", coalesce(sum(l.interest_repaid_derived), 0) as "Interest Collected", coalesce(sum(l.total_outstanding_derived), 0) as "Total Outstanding" from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') and l.loan_status_id = 300

reports.description: Per-member receivable breakdown for active loans: collected vs uncollected principal.
reports.reportSql: select c.display_name as "Member", l.account_no as "Account", lp.name as "Product", coalesce(l.principal_disbursed_derived, 0) as "Disbursed", coalesce(l.principal_repaid_derived, 0) as "Collected", coalesce(l.principal_outstanding_derived, 0) as "Uncollected", coalesce(l.total_outstanding_derived, 0) as "Total Outstanding" from m_loan l join m_client c on c.id = l.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id join m_product_loan lp on lp.id = l.product_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') and l.loan_status_id = 300 order by l.principal_outstanding_derived desc, c.display_name

reports.description: Member directory with Active/Dormant flags. Dormant = active client with no savings/loan/share transaction in the last 90 days.
reports.reportSql: select c.id as "Client Id", c.display_name as "Member", c.account_no as "Account", o.name as "Branch", case when c.status_enum = 100 then 'Pending' when c.status_enum = 300 and coalesce(act.last_activity, c.activation_date, c.submittedon_date) >= (current_date - interval '90 days') then 'Active' when c.status_enum = 300 then 'Dormant' when c.status_enum in (600, 700, 800) then 'Closed' else 'Other' end as "Status", to_char(c.activation_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Activated", to_char(c.submittedon_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Submitted", extract(month from coalesce(c.activation_date, c.submittedon_date))::int as "Month", extract(year from coalesce(c.activation_date, c.submittedon_date))::int as "Year", to_char(coalesce(act.last_activity, c.activation_date, c.submittedon_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Last Activity" from m_client c join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id left join (select client_id, max(txn_date) as last_activity from (select sa.client_id as client_id, sat.transaction_date as txn_date from m_savings_account_transaction sat join m_savings_account sa on sa.id = sat.savings_account_id where sat.is_reversed = false union all select l.client_id, lt.transaction_date from m_loan_transaction lt join m_loan l on l.id = lt.loan_id where lt.is_reversed = false union all select sha.client_id, shat.transaction_date from m_share_account_transactions shat join m_share_account sha on sha.id = shat.account_id) u group by client_id) act on act.client_id = c.id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') order by c.display_name

reports.description: Share capital inventory: Sold (active holdings), Promised (pending applications), Ready (authorized minus sold minus promised).
reports.reportSql: select sp.name as "Product", sp.total_shares as "Authorized", coalesce((select sum(sa.total_approved_shares) from m_share_account sa join m_client c on c.id = sa.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where sa.product_id = sp.id and sa.status_enum = 300 and o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%')), 0) as "Sold", coalesce((select sum(case when sa.status_enum = 100 then coalesce(sa.total_pending_shares, 0) when sa.status_enum = 200 then coalesce(sa.total_approved_shares, sa.total_pending_shares, 0) else 0 end) from m_share_account sa join m_client c on c.id = sa.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where sa.product_id = sp.id and sa.status_enum in (100, 200) and o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%')), 0) as "Promised", sp.total_shares - coalesce((select sum(sa.total_approved_shares) from m_share_account sa join m_client c on c.id = sa.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where sa.product_id = sp.id and sa.status_enum = 300 and o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%')), 0) - coalesce((select sum(case when sa.status_enum = 100 then coalesce(sa.total_pending_shares, 0) when sa.status_enum = 200 then coalesce(sa.total_approved_shares, sa.total_pending_shares, 0) else 0 end) from m_share_account sa join m_client c on c.id = sa.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where sa.product_id = sp.id and sa.status_enum in (100, 200) and o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%')), 0) as "Ready", coalesce((select sum(sa.total_approved_shares * sp.unit_price) from m_share_account sa join m_client c on c.id = sa.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id where sa.product_id = sp.id and sa.status_enum = 300 and o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%')), 0) as "Sold Value" from m_share_product sp where sp.name = 'FETAN Member Shares'

reports.description: Per-member share accounts with FETAN status labels: Promised (pending), Sold (active), Rejected/Closed.
reports.reportSql: select c.display_name as "Member", sa.account_no as "Account", sp.name as "Product", case when sa.status_enum in (100, 200) then 'Promised' when sa.status_enum = 300 then 'Sold' when sa.status_enum = 500 then 'Rejected' when sa.status_enum = 600 then 'Closed' else 'Other' end as "Status", coalesce(sa.total_approved_shares, 0) as "Approved Shares", coalesce(sa.total_pending_shares, 0) as "Pending Shares", coalesce(sa.total_approved_shares * sp.unit_price, 0) as "Value" from m_share_account sa join m_client c on c.id = sa.client_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id join m_share_product sp on sp.id = sa.product_id where o.hierarchy like concat((select h.hierarchy from m_office h where h.id = ${officeId}), '%') order by case sa.status_enum when 100 then 1 when 200 then 2 when 300 then 3 else 4 end, c.display_name
